description: Stage 4y dedicated cases (SAFE ROLLBACK: EnableSwitchCaseClause ships DEFAULT OFF; this group is the XML/AST/fallback gate on the default raw path; the on-state readings are printed by s4y-case-clause-takeover.mjs and recorded in HANDOFF-s4y.md): clause-level statements in a switch (`case 1: f();` - no braces). The switch case-block brace gets a catalog holding ONLY CaseClauseStatementPossibleShape (never the block-body catalog: expression/variable candidates would swallow `case <expr>:` and throw SourceRange is not set, the Stage 4p failure). The candidate accepts only at the first code unit after a clause colon (or after a previous clause statement) and builds a ShellStatementFamily shell (ScanRoot end); StatementBuilder.BuildCaseBlock collects the built statement shapes into the CaseClauseShape. Each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte; (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses give identical XML; (4) no shape/CatalogGuide leak in XML; (5) no file-level fallback. Takeover counters (SwitchCaseClauseMountCount / SwitchCaseClauseShellCount / BlockBodyStatementCount) are asserted by tests/statement-possible/s4y-case-clause-takeover.mjs and recorded in HANDOFF-s4y.md. The trap group is the safety gate: case bodies with braces, ternary case expressions, object literals, labels, nested switch, empty switch.

stage4y.stage: Stage 4y (switch clause-level statements taken over; block-level class shell behind a default-off flag)
stage4y.description: Clause-level statements (call, two statements in one clause, two clauses, default, arithmetic case expression, ternary case expression, if with a body, empty statement, let, no trailing semicolon, block-only clause, mixed clause forms, nested switch, empty switch) plus the trap group (object literal with a colon, label statement, object method containing a switch, plain switch case body).

cases.name: s4y-clause-ternary-case
cases.source: switch (x) { case a ? b : c: f(); }

cases.name: s4y-trap-switch-in-method
cases.source: const o = { m(){ switch (x) { case 1: f(); } } };

stage4aa.stage: Stage 4aa (clause shell closes at ; / EOF / ASI: StatementKind = ShellPlainExpression)
stage4aa.description: Clause-level statement takeover now delivered: multiple statements in one clause, declarations followed by statements, two clauses, ASI between clause statements (line break, and line break before the next case), case body after a clause, case body before a clause, three clauses, nested switch with two statements in the inner clause, empty statements in two clauses, default with two statements, and a switch inside a block.

cases.name: s4aa-clause-nested-switch
cases.source: switch (x) { case 1: switch (y) { case 2: f(); g(); } }
